shortDescription: Creates a resource of SMNTopic in Huawei Cloud

options.name: display_name
options.description: Topic display name, which is presented as the name of the email sender in an email message. The topic display name contains a maximum of 192 bytes.

options.name: domain
options.description: The name of the Domain to scope to (Identity v3). Currently only domain names are supported, and not domain IDs.

options.name: id
options.description: The ID of resource to be managed.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the topic to be created. The topic name is a string of 1 to 256 characters. It must contain upper- or lower-case letters, digits, hyphens (V(-)), and underscores (V(_)), and must start with a letter or digit.

options.name: project
options.description: The name of the Tenant (Identity v2) or Project (Identity v3). Currently only project names are supported, and not project IDs.

options.name: region
options.description: The region to which the project belongs.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the given object should exist in Huawei Cloud.

options.name: user
options.description: The user name to login with. Currently only user names are supported, and not user IDs.
